## Notes


### Coordinator endpoint

This hob uses Miele's private Zigbee profile for live telemetry. Some adapters may require coordinator-side support for a Miele gateway endpoint before the hob starts reporting cooking-zone updates.

When the coordinator endpoint is available, the hob publishes per-zone state, power and mode, plus aggregate `hob_power` and `extractor_demand` values which can be used by MQTT automations, for example to control an extractor fan.
<!-- Notes END: Do not edit below this line -->




## Exposes

### Zone count (numeric)
Number of available cooking zones.
Value can be found in the published state on the `zone_count` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.

### Active zones (numeric)
Number of cooking zones currently on.
Value can be found in the published state on the `active_zones` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.

### Hob power (numeric)
Average hob power across available zones.
Value can be found in the published state on the `hob_power` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
The minimal value is `0` and the maximum value is `100`.
The unit of this value is `%`.

### Extractor demand (numeric)
Extractor demand derived from average and peak zone power.
Value can be found in the published state on the `extractor_demand` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
The minimal value is `0` and the maximum value is `100`.
The unit of this value is `%`.

### Zone 0 state (binary)
Zone 0 cooking state.
Value can be found in the published state on the `zone_0_state` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
If value equals `ON` zone 0 state is ON, if `OFF` OFF.

### Zone 0 power (numeric)
Zone 0 manual power level; 0 for special automatic modes.
Value can be found in the published state on the `zone_0_power` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
The minimal value is `0` and the maximum value is `9`.

### Zone 0 mode (enum)
Zone 0 operating mode.
Value can be found in the published state on the `zone_0_mode` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
The possible values are: `off`, `normal`, `twin_booster_1`, `twin_booster_2`, `keep_warm`, `keep_warm_plus`, `tempcontrol_fry_1`, `tempcontrol_fry_2`, `tempcontrol_fry_3`, `tempcontrol_simmer`, `unknown`.
